intro: A London-based graduate in Business, Computing & IT from Aston University. I research trades across rates, FX and commodities, build the tools to test them, and write down everything I learn along the way.

background.text: Building Python and TypeScript tools for a UAE government client's crypto-regulation platform, including an API lookup tool that saves around 3 hours a week and an LLM chatbot for organising case information.
Helped prepare a £1m GBP/USD forward hedge on Bloomberg, built forecasts and cash-flow models for a ~£300m acquisition, and automated a monthly manual process with Excel VBA.
Graduated with a 2:1. Modules included Software for Analytics, Optimisation & Decision Analytics and Business Analysis & Data Mining.
Built cash-flow analysis for a live capital raise and presented project economics to investors in a joint-venture pitch that raised $18m.

items.label: Learning
items.text: Programming fundamentals through Harvard's CS50, and rebuilding my maths from A level up for quant work.

items.label: Building
items.text: Trading projects in Python, C++, OCaml and Rust, focused on FX, gold and bonds. Next up: a limit order book in Rust.

items.label: Waiting on
items.text: The 9 December FOMC decision, which will score my SOFR trade memo.

contact: I'm looking for off-cycle internships and graduate roles starting September 2027, across trading, quant research, investment management and investment banking. The quickest way to reach me is email.
